description: Manage evroc networking resources (VPCs, subnets, security groups, public IPs). Trigger on networking/VPC/subnet/security group/public IP keywords. Block on compute/IAM/storage/load balancer/Think.

cases.query: Create a new evroc VPC named my-network with CIDR block 10.0.0.0/8
cases.rationale: Direct VPC creation request on evroc cloud

cases.query: Create a subnet in zone a on evroc connected to my VPC
Add an ingress rule to my evroc security group to allow SSH on port 22
cases.rationale: Security group rule management on evroc

cases.query: Create a public IP on evroc so my VM can reach the internet
cases.rationale: Public IP creation on evroc networking

cases.query: Create an evroc VM named web-server in zone a
Set up a load balancer in front of my evroc VMs
cases.rationale: Load balancer management, not networking resources

cases.query: Create a subnet for zone b
expected_behavior: Matches the --zone flag with the subnet zone suffix
Requires --vpc flag — asks the user which VPC to use

cases.query: Add a rule to my security group allowing traffic from my other security group
expected_behavior: Uses --security-group flag to reference the source security group
Uses --direction=Ingress and --protocol=All with --port=0 for all traffic

cases.query: Create a new public IP on evroc
expected_behavior: Lists existing public IPs first with evroc networking publicip list
Checks whether the 3-IP account quota would be exceeded
If quota is full, warns the user and suggests deleting an unused IP before creating
